design_archetype: Trading Card Collector & Stadium Arena (Anti-AI Physical Craft)
emotional_tone: High-octane, physical collector nostalgia, stadium floodlight energy, premium athletic craft
theme_strategy: Dual theme support. Dark Pitch mode (default for gaming & stadium vibe) and Stadium Chalk light mode with physical paper/foil textures.

rules: Headings must use font-display ('Barlow Condensed') with tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for heavy-weight athletic feel.
Card stats, rarity numbers, and pricing tags must use font-mono ('JetBrains Mono') with uppercase tracking-widest.
Never use default generic sans for section titles or hero headlines.
H1 ceiling: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl maximum.

3d_tilt_cards.description: Interactive mouse/touch tracking 3D tilt with real perspective, dynamic holographic reflection, glare sheen overlay, and 3D double-sided flip button to view card stats & authentication slab data.
3d_tilt_cards.styles: perspective: 1000px, transform-style: preserve-3d, transition: transform 0.1s ease-out

3d_stadium_scroll_stage.description: Scroll-driven 3D stadium tunnel with angled grid pitch lines, glowing spotlight cones, and floating collector cards flying in 3D perspective along scroll position.
3d_stadium_scroll_stage.implementation: Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform on CSS 3D perspective containers, lightweight for mid-range mobile performance.

collector_slab_badges.description: PSA/BGS-style physical grading slab tops (e.g. 'FLEXO GEM MT 10', 'LIMITED EDITION #001/500', holographic foil stamps, gold foil embossed borders).

texture_overlay.description: Subtle paper grain / noise SVG overlay combined with metallic inner strokes to give cards a real printed card stock weight.

Header.features: Crystal glassmorphism bar (backdrop-blur-xl), FlexoCards 3D collector logo with metallic badge, links (Home, Explore, Create Card, Pricing, Blog, Help), theme toggle, Sign In / Dashboard CTA, mobile slide-over binder drawer.

sections: Hero Section: 3D stadium floodlight arena with 3 interactive floating 3D player cards that tilt on mouse movement and flip on click to show stats & QR code.
Live Collector Ticker: Animated marquee showcasing recent Indian community card creations (Cricket, Kabaddi, BGMI, Football, Chess).
Sports Directory Preview: Interactive search + category chips (60+ sports/esports) with 3D card preview cards.
3D Card Showcase & Tier Gallery: Interactive 25+ templates with free/basic/pro/premium/exclusive tier filters and holographic foil previews.
Scroll-Driven 3D Stadium Stage: How It Works 4-step interactive binder journey (1. Select Sport, 2. Customize Stats & Photos, 3. Add Holo Foil & Grading, 4. Print / Share & Monetize).
Community & Benefits Bento Grid: High-density asymmetry showing Razorpay instant checkout, HD PDF/PNG export, print-ready 300 DPI, and social collection links.
Pricing Preview: Quick view of plan tiers with INR currency toggle.
FAQ Accordion & Contact Form: Anti-AI styled interactive dropdowns and contact box.

Explore.features: Collector Binder Grid view, 60+ sports search, category filter chips (Cricket, Kabaddi, Football, Esports, Badminton, Chess...), template tier badges, 3D card hover tilt & quick view modal.

Pricing.features: 4 plans (Free, Starter, Collector Pro, Academy/Club), Monthly vs Yearly billing toggle in INR, Razorpay badge, feature comparison table, FAQ.

Blog.features: Collector Journal magazine layout, featured article hero with holographic badge, sports card news grid, tag filters, newsletter subscription.

Help.features: Knowledge base binder, search bar, topic category cards, contact support form, interactive video guide previews.

Footer.features: Massive 3D metallic 'FLEXOCARDS' display logo watermark, newsletter box, sports catalog quick links, legal/privacy links, Indian payment trust badges (Razorpay, UPI, Cards).

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign ONLY the public pages (Home, Explore, Pricing, Blog, Help, Header, Footer). DO NOT touch card editor, dashboard, or admin components.
Ensure all components are implemented in .jsx files.
Keep existing data-testid attributes intact on interactive elements.
Incorporate 3D card tilt using CSS perspective and framer-motion mouse movement.
Implement double-sided 3D card flip so users can flip player cards to view stats, radar chart, or collector QR codes.
Ensure mobile responsiveness (390px+) with smooth performance on mid-range Android devices.
Ensure high contrast in both Light (Stadium Chalk) and Dark (Pitch Obsidian) themes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic AI templates, centered plain cards, or standard SaaS layouts.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating headers; always use backdrop-blur glassmorphism or solid surfaces with 1px crisp borders.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Never apply universal CSS transition: all; specify properties explicitly.
